essence: The mantra-knower is beyond doubt and capable of restraint and grace.
All gods and the speaker bow to him without doubt.
The declared divine field extends ten yojanas all around.
There would be victory, gain, honor, manliness, and beloved.
One obtains death in six months unless Shiva himself protects.
